title: How to Learn Responsibly About Palestine
subtitle: A practical method for checking reports, images, dates, and claims
summary: Palestine is surrounded by fast-moving claims and powerful images. A responsible reader checks the original source, date, location, evidence, and independent confirmation before believing or sharing a report.

sections.title: Check Before You Share
sections.body: Care for Palestinians should deepen a commitment to truth, not weaken it. The Quran warns believers to investigate reports so that people are not harmed through ignorance (Quran 49:6). A false caption or invented quotation can damage innocent people and discredit a just concern.

sections.title: Five Quick Checks
sections.body:
Ask five questions: Who first made the claim? When and where did the event occur? What evidence is shown? Does the source distinguish fact from allegation or opinion? Has a credible, independent source confirmed the central point?

For photographs and videos, find the earliest upload and check whether the image is old, cropped, or from another place. For numbers, identify who produced them, what they count, and whether later revisions exist. Until a claim is verified, label it honestly as unconfirmed.

sections.title: Use the Right Source for the Question
sections.body:
Primary documents establish what an institution officially said. Historians reconstruct events from many records. Human-rights investigators assess evidence under stated methods. News reports document events as information emerges. Religious texts explain why a place or cause matters to believers. No single source type answers every question.

Apply the same standard to claims that support one's position and claims that challenge it. Responsible learning is not false neutrality; it is disciplined truthfulness.

sections.title: Truthful Advocacy Is Stronger Advocacy
sections.body: The most helpful advocate is careful with evidence, transparent about uncertainty, and unwilling to use another person's suffering as a slogan. Verify first, speak precisely, correct mistakes openly, and keep human dignity at the center.

quranVerses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍۢ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍۢ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَٰدِمِينَ
quranVerses.translation: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.
